# Tashqi YouTube loyihalari (ko'rib chiqilgan, 2026-11-14)

| Loyiha | Litsenziya | Nima qiladi | Kerakli kalitlar (pullik bo'lishi mumkin) | Holat |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [mromidev/claude-animated-shorts](https://github.com/mromidev/claude-animated-shorts) | MIT | 3D dunyoda 2D multfilm-hikoya (three.js + Remotion) | yo'q | **O'rnatilgan**: `.claude/skills/cartoon-3d-short`, ishlaydigan loyiha `tools/remotion-cartoon` |
| [darkzOGx/youtube-automation-agent](https://github.com/darkzOGx/youtube-automation-agent) | MIT | Mavzu, ssenariy, muqova, SEO, joylash | OPENAI_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, REPLICATE_API_KEY, YouTube OAuth | Kod ko'rildi; ishga tushirish uchun pullik kalitlar kerak |
| [yashaiguy-dev/faceless-youtube-agents](https://github.com/yashaiguy-dev/faceless-youtube-agents) | ko'rsatilmagan | Kanal uslubini nusxalab video yasaydi, YouTube'ga qoralama qiladi | GATHOS_IMAGE_API_KEY, GATHOS_TTS_API_KEY (gathos.com, pullik) | Litsenziyasiz: kodini repoga ko'chirib bo'lmaydi |
| [ChaituRajSagar/gemini-youtube-automation](https://github.com/ChaituRajSagar/gemini-youtube-automation) | ko'rsatilmagan | Gemini + GitHub Actions bilan kunlik video | GOOGLE_API_KEY, PEXELS_API_KEY (bepul tarif bor), YouTube OAuth | Litsenziyasiz: kodini repoga ko'chirib bo'lmaydi |

Mahalliy nusxa olish: `git clone --depth 1 <havola> tools/external/<nom>` (bu papka git'ga qo'shilmaydi).

Eslatma: bizning `shorts-agent` (Bilarmidingiz, apex_wealths) shu vazifalarni bepul (Gemini + OmniVoice/Edge TTS + GitHub Actions) bajaradi; yuqoridagilar faqat g'oya va qo'shimcha imkoniyat manbai.
